title: US Midterms may change Iran war stalemate, but tanker inefficiency will remain
section_path: US Midterms may change Iran war stalemate, but tanker inefficiency will remain
section_path_text: US Midterms may change Iran war stalemate, but tanker inefficiency will remain
summary:
Main
President Trump has made much noise about possible action against Iran following the US Midterm elections. We see three broad scenarios for tanker markets. Large-scale escalation: initially bullish for rates, but then weakened by tanker demand destruction
The most extreme scenario would be a return to large-scale bombing or an escalation in warfare, with significant US attacks on Iranian military sites and infrastructure followed by Iranian retaliation against US strategic assets in the Middle East and/or other Middle East countries' infrastructure, including energy infrastructure.
